decision.reason: User-defined generic nominal storage already uses native generated Go carriers, and no exact new compiled or bytecode owner is material across three unlike applications.

native_carriers.slot: Slot_i64 with int64 value and generation fields
native_carriers.buffer: VersionedBuffer_i64 with native Array and int64 mutation fields

compiled_owner_refresh.conclusion: The new control disproves generic nominal materialization as the shared map cost. Its storage and dispatch are native. Pointer-backed nullable scalar construction is a separate general representation candidate, but the allocating leaves differ between direct typed reads and runtime map conversion/recovery.

nullable_scalar_evidence.reason: The shared representation is *int64, but no exact allocating leaf spans all three programs and a global nullable ABI change requires a separate semantic census and design gate.

bytecode_owner_refresh.conclusion: All material descendants belong to already-closed dispatcher, member/call, raw-integer, frame, stack, cast, propagation/type, or cache families.
